title: Confirming the Qualifying Special Need for a Special Needs Plan Before Coverage Begins
content:
A Special Needs Plan may be held only by a member who has the special need the plan is built for, and the plan confirms that need from its own authoritative source before coverage begins.

### The evidence condition

> The enrollment intake carries evidence of the qualifying special need from the package's authoritative source, and that evidence is not the member's own statement alone.

The evidence recorded on the intake is one of three kinds, and of no other: a match on the monthly state Medicaid eligibility file, a prescriber attestation held on file, or a completed institutional level-of-care assessment held on file. The condition is tested on the intake record, matched to the intake the election was taken on, before the need is put to the authoritative source and before coverage is brought into force. It is tested on what that record holds, not on what is said in a call.

### The source each kind of package draws on

For a dual eligible plan the source is the monthly state Medicaid eligibility file; for a chronic condition plan it is a prescriber attestation confirmed against the member's claim history; for an institutional plan it is a completed level-of-care assessment.

### What the member's own account supports

A member's own account of their diagnosis or their Medicaid status is enough to take the election and start the enquiry, and never enough to effectuate coverage; a member told otherwise by anyone is put right plainly.

### An attestation still outstanding

Where a prescriber attestation is outstanding the plan may effectuate coverage for the package's attestation validity days while it waits, and ends the enrollment if the attestation never arrives.

### Confirming the need again

The qualifying need is confirmed again on the package's reverification frequency, and a member is never asked to prove it more often than that.

### Basis Q and A

**A member says their prescriber has diagnosed the condition their Special Needs Plans package is built for, and nothing has yet reached the intake. What does that support?** Taking the election and starting the enquiry. It does not support bringing coverage into force, the evidence condition not being met by the member's own statement alone.

**The intake holds a completed institutional level-of-care assessment. Is the evidence condition met?** It is. A completed institutional level-of-care assessment on file is one of the three kinds of evidence the condition accepts.

**The intake holds nothing but a note of what the member said on the telephone. Is the evidence condition met?** It is not, that note being the member's own statement alone.
